$comment: Signal operational failure boundaries. Expected outcomes (asking for results with questions still unanswered, a dimension with too few numeric answers to score) remain typed engine outcomes shown as ordinary page content and are not Aegis faults. See src/Echelon.Signal.Application/Boundary.fs.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (assessment page)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (Wire.handle). A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on, or that names an item or answer code the assessment does not define, is MESSAGE_INVALID. Programming defects (for example an event name index.html sends that the engine does not know) keep Aegis fail-loud semantics and surface as a Limen bridge error.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (administrator page)
boundaries.$comment: Every administrator kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (AdminWire.handle), including the continuations of Fides' sign-in and Arca's storage work that the kernel's answers resume. A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on is MESSAGE_INVALID; a kernel that lacks the Http, Storage or signal.host support the page needs, or answers a request the engine never made, is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Expected storage outcomes (conflicts, unknown outcomes, refusals, offline) are typed results shown as notices, not faults (AdminWire, ProviderContract.meaning).

boundaries.name: Report export downloads through Limen's files capability
boundaries.$comment: An export (a formal snapshot's report JSON, sections CSV or lineage, ADM-023) is handed to the browser with limen.files' download operation from inside AdminWire.handle, so the dispatch boundary above guards it. Its outcomes are typed: Downloaded is a notice; NeedsGesture, Refused, Unsupported or a kernel without the files pack are notices that nothing was saved (SIGNAL.REPORT.NOT_SAVED, SIGNAL.REPORT.NO_DOWNLOADS), never faults. The export is verified against the stored snapshot first (ReportLibrary.intact) and carries no storage location or credential (ADM-025, ADM-077).

boundaries.name: GitHub through Arca's GitHub adapter
boundaries.$comment: Operational GitHub failures are classified by Aegis's GitHub integration inside Arca's adapter (Arca.GitHub.Faults over Aegis.Integration.GitHub) and reach Signal as typed StorageFailure values with their Aegis fault code; Signal presents them through StorageFaults and never retries automatically (AER-002, AER-032, ADM-026).

boundaries.name: Browser DOM, print, history navigation and clipboard
boundaries.$comment: Execution occurs browser-side (DOM projection, the browser's print, history.replaceState for the live URL). The engine requests two Limen effects, a Navigation replace (LURL-001) and a Clipboard writeText of the finalized submission link; their Failure outcomes are typed notices to the respondent, not Aegis faults, and a result for an effect the engine did not request (or already heard) is MESSAGE_INVALID at the dispatch boundary. This declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Signal does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured; in the browser the standard-error sink writes to the console.
